premiere.name: Lease Signing
premiere.description: Four strangers, one rooftop, twelve weeks. Everyone is lovely. Nobody is relaxed.

scenes.plot: Unpacking spills onto the terrace while the wrong takeout order sits on the table — somebody has to say it, nobody wants to. The room-with-the-view assignment resurfaces very politely. A first toast happens, and everyone chooses their opening move.
First impressions of the housemates — who they'd trust with a secret by week twelve, who they're already watching, and what they're not saying on the terrace.
